parsed.explanation: Border acceptance of foreign/X passports with no extra documentation, protected bathroom access, discrimination prohibition in accommodations, high documented public acceptance, and a police recording unit are strong traveler-facing positives. Main exposure is custody: placement is unregulated, based on municipal sex designation with preference only as one factor, frequently segregating trans detainees in an Extra Care wing, with documented initial male-wing placement, molestation, and court recognition of mismatched-wing harm, and no published remedial guidelines. Rising discrimination reports and only six discrimination convictions also indicate recourse is not reliably effective. Resident gender-recognition requirements are not deducted. This combines low everyday exposure with a serious but low-frequency custody risk.
